notes: The failing test itself was left untouched (test files are frozen in a fix step); the fix is in test/support/pg.ts, a test-support helper. The e2e stack's database part starts before its engine/control listener and calls startCluster -> freePort, and the global test cluster also uses freePort, so either could take 39080/39081. freePort now skips both defaults and retries. I reproduced the failure with a listener on 39080 and confirmed it is the port collision; after the change the full suite reports 354/354 passing with 0 failures in .l4-out/junit.xml. Note that `pnpm run test` exits 0 even when a test fails because the repository global setup/teardown masks the test runner's exit code, so I checked the JUnit report rather than only the exit status. lint and typecheck pass.

reason: Read e2e/test_e2e_stack.py and e2e/conftest.py. Both carry the l4 marker for C-67438cd6 and appear as run tests in the report. The assertions discriminate the scenario's two branches and the teardown, so the per-test evidence hold can be waived.
